_readme: Every visible string in the preview harness and the README screenshot comes from this file.
Replace the text with whatever you want shown publicly, then re-run:
Keep the '_shows' notes in mind — each row is in the shot to demonstrate something.
Room at 340px pane width: title ~45 chars before it ellipsizes, subtitle ~50.
A session off the default permission level carries 'permissionLevel' — its pill costs the title about 12 of those characters.

'turn' is 'working' or 'waiting' — a turn in flight. 'working' suppresses the attention border, 'waiting' adds the Needs input pill. Only set it on a row whose ageMinutes is inside chatTags.recentMinutes, or the fixture disagrees with the provider.
'autoApproving' draws the live session-approval pill, which is what a policy-restricted machine sees instead of a permission level.
'_shows' and '_readme' are ignored by both builders. Everything else is rendered.
'panes' maps a pane id to the sessions that pane draws, so no two frames of the shot
show the same chats. A pane with no entry falls back to every session. The harness
(build-preview.mjs) has no panes of its own and draws the whole pool.
Row order inside a pane is by ageMinutes ascending, except the sort pane which goes by
createdDaysAgo. build-screenshot.mjs hovers rows by index, so in 'rowmenu' the
second-newest row opens the menu, and in 'buttons' the fourth-newest must keep a
hand-written title and subtitle or the dimmed-button guard stops being visible.
A 720px pane holds about nine 54px rows plus six group headings. Past that the
grouped pane pushes its archived section off the bottom.
